about-me.introduction: Hello, I'm Muhammet Banzaroğlu. I'm a Computer Engineering graduate from Istanbul Technical University. I have a deep interest in software development, algorithms, and data structures. Currently, I'm actively working as a Frontend Developer at Delege AI, building component-based, best practice React applications using modern technologies like React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, NextAuth, React Query, Zod, and Zustand.

ituoder.before: Additionally, as a member of the
ituoder.after: Board of Directors, I develop projects for ITU students and alumni and actively participate in community work. I enjoy continuously learning, discovering ways to effectively use new technologies, and implementing them in my projects.

degrees.description: I specialized in software development, algorithm analysis, and data structures. I excelled in courses related to computer organization and microprocessors.
During this 35 ECTS credit semester, I had the chance to immerse myself in Greek culture and language. I also traveled to over 10 countries with an international student community.

experience_list.title: Frontend Developer
experience_list.description: Actively working on frontend development of the Delege AI web application. Building component-based, best practice React applications using React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, NextAuth, React Query, Zod, and Zustand. Leading codebase refactoring and new feature development within new UI design frameworks.

experience_list.title: Frontend Developer
experience_list.description: Solely responsible for both frontend development and UI/UX design and improvement processes of the UniKazan education platform's admin panel, web application, and user panel pages. Building component-based, best practice React applications using React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, React Query, Zod, and Zustand.
